cta.title: Ready to Compare?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of users who compare lists every day. Free, private, and instant.

0.a: Yes. All comparison happens in your browser. Your lists are never sent to any server or stored anywhere.

1.a: Paste text or upload .txt, .csv, .tsv files. Items can be separated by newlines, commas, semicolons, or tabs.

2.q: How many items can I compare?
2.a: No hard limit. Handles tens of thousands of items smoothly since all processing is local.

3.a: AI mode uses DeepSeek to find fuzzy matches like 'John Smith' vs 'Smith, John', detect typos, and generate an intelligent analysis summary. Uses 1 credit per comparison.

4.a: Uses the Dice coefficient: 2 x (common items) / (total A + total B), giving a percentage of list similarity.
